title: Quezon town declares state of calamity, prays for rain amid El Niño

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY—The local government of Catanauan, Quezon, declared a state of calamity due to the effects of El Niño as it appealed for divine intervention to help residents cope with the prolonged dry spell. On Tuesday, Nov. 24, the municipal government stated the declaration resulted from agricultural losses amounting to P147 million, including P95 million in damage to coconut crops. Earlier, the towns of Alabat, Jomalig, General Nakar, and Guinayangan in Quezon province also declared states of calamity due to the effects of El Niño.
